correctness.rationale: The exact third-edge conflict table implies two partitions of E(Y_n) into n pairwise-conflicting triples; upper equality forces s_{i+3}=s_i and nonzero spokes of one residue class, then alternating horizontal layer pairs, possible iff 6|n. Explicit six-periodic witnesses with two residue-dependent seam deletions give lower n or n−1 for every n≥4, and a separate n=3 witness gives 2. Exhaustive finite independent conflict-graph optimization (3≤n≤10), all 178 witnesses (3≤n≤180), and equality census n=3,6,9,12 corroborate the unrestricted proof; finite data alone would not prove it. Risk: a missed bridge or seam interaction; complete pair table and periodic seam checks address this.

Their statements do not imply the six-residue formula or six extremal packings. Closely named graph families and distinct packing invariants were compared by statements, not titles. value.rationale: This computes the actual maximum edge-open packing, a natural extremal graph invariant, on the infinite cycle-by-edge Cartesian family with a sharp mod-six transition. The optimality proof and explicit constructions bridge a strict unit gap left by the degree bound, and exactly classify every n-edge optimum (six forms) whenever the global bound is attained. Both complete parameter range and extremizer rigidity are structural, not arbitrary small-case counting; outside multiples of six only size, not full census, is asserted.
